added: Storage health results distinguish potentially unreadable chapters from files the scanner could not verify.
improved: CBZ checks now use Mihon's own archive engine, the same reader used for offline manga.
Storage scan failures are reported as inconclusive instead of automatically labeling downloads damaged.
fixed: Corrected the CBZ health-check compatibility issue that flagged 78 out of 78 saved chapters as potentially unreadable on Android.
Unknown Android storage file sizes are no longer treated as proof of corrupted CBZ downloads.
